mapper.select: select po_id from srm_po_line where po_line_id = #{poLineId}
select plant_cd from srm_po where po_id = #{poId}

select l.po_line_id, l.po_id, l.line_no, l.item_id, l.unit_cd, l.qty, l.cancel_qty, l.recv_qty, l.line_status, i.unit_cd as base_unit, case when l.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 else uc.factor end as factor, coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd)) as unit_scale, coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = i.unit_cd), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = i.unit_cd)) as base_scale from srm_po_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join mst_unit_conv uc on uc.item_id = l.item_id and uc.from_unit = l.unit_cd and uc.to_unit = i.unit_cd and uc.use_yn = 'Y' where l.po_line_id = #{poLineId} for update of l
select exists (select 1 from srm_po_receipt where trx_ref = #{trxRef})
select coalesce(sum(qty), 0) from srm_po_receipt where po_line_id = #{poLineId} and occurred_on = #{on}
mapper.insert: insert into srm_po_receipt (comp_cd, po_id, po_line_id, occurred_on, qty, trx_ref, asn_line_id, lot_id, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{poId}, #{poLineId}, #{on}, #{qty}, #{trxRef}, #{asnLineId}, #{lotId}, #{by})
mapper.update: update srm_po_receipt set lot_id = #{lotId} where trx_ref = #{trxRef} and qty > 0 and lot_id is null
mapper.select: select po_line_id, occurred_on, asn_line_id, lot_id from srm_po_receipt where trx_ref = #{trxRef}
select a.asn_id, l.po_line_id, a.status from srm_asn_line l join srm_asn a on a.asn_id = l.asn_id where l.asn_line_id = #{asnLineId} for update of a
select coalesce((select a.ack_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIAL') from srm_po_ack a join srm_po p on p.po_id = a.po_id where a.po_id = #{poId} and a.rev = p.rev order by a.ack_seq desc limit 1), false)
